section.title: Delete account
section.description: Your account is deleted for good after 14 days; sign in again before then to restore it.

confirm.title: Delete your account?
confirm.description: Your account will be deleted for good on {{date}}. Until then, sign in again to restore it. After that your profile, study streak and friends are deleted; your messages show "Deleted account".

banner: Your account will be deleted for good on {{date}} · sign in before then to restore it
bannerUndated: Your account is waiting to be deleted · sign in within 14 days of your request to restore it

restore.description_one: Your account will be deleted for good on {{date}} ({{count}} day left). Restore it to keep using it: your servers, messages and study streak are all still there.
